dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the South Whitemud Lake area (NTS 84D/NE). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the point features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 558, Surficial Geology of the South Whitemud Lake Area (NTS 84D/NE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the South Whitemud Lake Area (NTS 84D/NE) (GIS data, point features)
